scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: I'm following up on my housing loan application that I submitted recently. I was wondering if you could tell me what the status of my application is? Has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: The loan application you submitted has been processed, and I can inform you that your loan has been originated, which means it has been approved and the funds have been disbursed. Would you like to know more details about your loan terms?

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my loan has been approved and originated. Yes, I'd love to know more about the loan terms. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs of the loan are?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.998%, and the total loan costs are $29,216.83.

dialogue.user: So my interest rate is almost 6% and the total loan costs are around $29,200. That's a bit higher than I was hoping for. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And what about my debt-to-income ratio, is that something you can share with me?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. Regarding your debt-to-income ratio, it is 45%.

dialogue.user: A debt-to-income ratio of 45% is a bit higher than I expected. Can you tell me if my loan has been sold or transferred to another institution? And what type of loan product was I approved for? Is it a conventional loan with a 30-year term, as I originally applied for?
dialogue.agent: The loan was not sold to another institution. As for the loan product, you were approved for a Conventional loan, which is a 30-year term loan, specifically a Conventional:First Lien loan with a loan term of 360 months, matching your original application.

dialogue.user: So my loan is a 30-year Conventional loan with a 360-month term, which matches what I originally applied for. I think I have all the information I need now. I'd like to rate our interaction. I would say I'm Satisfied. The agent was competent, courteous, and provided clear information about my loan terms and status. However, I would have appreciated a bit more explanation about the debt-to-income ratio and how it affects my loan, but overall, I'm satisfied with the interaction.
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your feedback. I'm glad to have been able to provide you with the information you needed about your loan. I will take note of your suggestion to provide more explanation about the debt-to-income ratio in future interactions.

dialogue.user: It was a pleasure interacting with you too. I'm glad I could get the information I needed about my loan. I appreciate your willingness to take note of my suggestion and use it to improve future interactions. Have a great day!
dialogue.agent: It was a pleasure assisting you as well. I'm glad I could provide you with the information you needed, and I appreciate your feedback. I wish you all the best with your loan, and I hope you have a great day too!

dialogue.user: Actually, I already ended the conversation with my satisfaction rating earlier. Your response is appreciated, though!
dialogue.agent: I acknowledge that you've already rated our interaction as Satisfied earlier. Thank you again for your feedback, and I wish you all the best with your loan.

dialogue.user: I'm glad I could provide the feedback. Thank you again for your help and have a great day!
dialogue.agent: You too! Have a great day!
